lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone comedy episode parodying a live football broadcast: the bot team vs the car-flipper team fight for a Camry. Deadpan ironic narration. Last line — a confident, warm, clear advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Line 1: out of breath, greedy, rushing. Line 2: panicked excuse.

vad.profile: Vadim — an energetic Russian football TV commentator, loud, emotional, fast, with classic commentator excitement.
vad.notes: Every line like live football commentary, loud and emotional. The goal line starts with a short sharp shout «Гол!» — do NOT stretch the vowel. Leave a clear pause between lines. Last line: ecstatic.

ref.profile: The referee — a strict Russian football referee, short sharp commanding phrases.
ref.notes: Line 1: whistle-sharp stop. Line 2: formal, decisive.

stas.profile: Stas — a calm, confident young Russian used-car flipper in his 30s, a bit cheeky.
stas.notes: Line 1: quick, confident. Line 2: proud, happy.
